statements.headline: Severe Weather Statement
statements.summary: Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees. Locations impacted include... Barnesville, Bethesda, Quaker City, Belmont, Beallsville, Morristown, Salesville, Wilson, Somerton, Alledonia, Fairview and Barkcamp State Park.
